title: The Value of Labels in Data Selection for Least Squares
abstract: arXiv:2611.28169v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Suppose a selector sees a finite labelled dataset and chooses $n$ of its rows, with repetition. Ordinary least squares is then fitted to the rows that were chosen, without weights, and the excess loss of the fit on the full dataset is measured in units of the optimal loss. Without further assumptions this ratio does not decay with $n$. We examine the problem for $d$ features and rows of normalized leverage at most $\kappa$, and determine or bound the leading constants. A selector that must establish its rule before seeing the labels has an optimal worst-case ratio of $d\kappa/n$ to leading order, whatever use it makes of the features. With scalar labels, a selector that sees the labels achieves a value between $d\kappa/(2n)$ and $d\kappa\Lambda_d/n$, where $\Lambda_d<1$ is the rounding constant of mean selection. translated_title: 最小二乘数据选择中标签的价值
translated_abstract: 假设一个选择者面对一个有限的带标签数据集，并从中选取 $n$ 行（允许重复）。随后对被选中的行拟合普通最小二乘（不加权），并以最优损失为单位衡量该拟合在整个数据集上的超额损失。在没有进一步假设的情况下，该比率不会随 $n$ 衰减。我们研究了具有 $d$ 个特征、且各行归一化杠杆值至多为 $\kappa$ 的情形，并确定或界定了其主导常数。必须在看到标签之前就确定其选择规则的选择者，无论怎样利用特征信息，其最优最坏情况比率在一阶意义下均为 $d\kappa/n$。而对于标量标签，能够看到标签的选择者可以取得介于 $d\kappa/(2n)$ 与 $d\kappa\Lambda_d/n$ 之间的值，其中 $\Lambda_d<1$ 是均值选择的舍入常数。当 $d\le4$ 时，该常数为 $d\kappa/2$，因此在这种情形下标签恰好价值两倍；而对于单一特征的情形……（原文截断）
tldr: 该论文量化了最小二乘数据选择中“看到标签”的价值：仅用特征的最优选择者最坏情况超额损失率为 $d\kappa/n$，而利用标签可将主导常数改善至 $d\kappa/2$，即在低维（$d\le4$）情形下标签恰好带来两倍的收益。
en_tdlr: This paper quantifies the value of labels in data selection for least squares, showing that the optimal worst-case excess-loss ratio improves from $d\kappa/n$ (feature-only selection) to $d\kappa/2$ with label information—meaning labels are worth exactly a factor of two in low dimensions ($d\le4$).
